evals.prompt:
Audit this checkout form component before we ship:
Payment
Invalid
Pay
Target is WCAG 2.2 AA.
assertions: Opens with a coverage note stating what markup alone can and cannot verify (e.g. actual screen-reader output, live focus order)
Every finding cites a specific success criterion with number, name, and level (e.g. 2.1.1 Keyboard [A], 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value [A])
Every finding names the user group and assistive tech it blocks (e.g. keyboard-only, NVDA/VoiceOver users)
The div-as-button is a blocker for keyboard and screen-reader users; minor issues like the lock icon's alt text are not inflated to blocker
Contrast for #999 on #fff is given as a computed ratio (about 2.85:1) against the 4.5:1 threshold, and the 20x20 target is checked against 2.5.8's 24x24 minimum
Each finding is tagged [auto] or [manual] and has a concrete fix
Ends with a 'what's solid' section and a must-verify-with-live-AT checklist
Does not claim a pass on any behavior the markup can't show, and does not invent elements not in the snippet
